annotations.text:
KAN-4 — receipts project and entry list (slice 1/4).

Baseline is inherited unchanged from KAN-5's canvas and design/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md (both already re-derived from the owner-set §Aesthetic direction — verified current, no re-derivation needed here). 01 and 04 are reused byte-for-byte from KAN-5's ListEmpty.dc.html and Main.dc.html, per this ticket's Notes for design. 02, 03 and 05 are new: this ticket owns list loading, list error, and pull-to-refresh.

Every state (loading skeleton, empty, error's own layout aside, populated, refreshing) uses the identical 64px row / 40×40 thumbnail / 88px-min right slot geometry. Swapping states — or KAN-6 swapping in merchant + amount later — never reflows the list.
Deviation from the system's "one way forward, one way back" rule: 03 offers only Try again. This screen is the app's front door (no picker, no screen behind it) — there is no "back" to give.

Two additions to DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §5: the skeleton row (--sunk fill, same geometry as the entry row, opacity-pulse) and the refresh spinner (--accent stroke — the same progress exemption the upload bar uses).
